```sql
WITH region_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'New Brunswick'
    AND border_type = 'province'
),
raster_subset AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Clip(
      rast,
      (SELECT geom FROM region_geom),
      TRUE
    ) AS clipped_rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geom FROM region_geom))
),
slope_raster AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Slope(clipped_rast, 1, '32BF') AS slope_rast
  FROM raster_subset
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(value), 2) AS avg_slope_degrees
FROM (
  SELECT
    (ST_SummaryStats(slope_rast, TRUE)).*
  FROM slope_raster
) AS stats;
```
